violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED BOILED EGGS IN ONE-DOOR STANDING COOLER AT 57F. EGGS WERE PLACED IN COOLER THE NIGHT BEFORE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: EGGS DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: ONE DOOR STANDING COOLER FOR CUSTOMERS. OBSERVED THE COOLER ABOVE TO BE AT 60F AND HOLDING FOOD ~57F. DO NOT USE THIS COOLER TO STORE BOILED EGGS OR OTHER FOOD FOR CUSTOMERS UNTIL IT IS SET TO 33-35F AND HOLDING FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW. YOU MAY USE IT TO STORE POP AND WATER WHICH DO NOT REQUIRE TEMPERATURE CONTROL. NO CFM ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: PIC AGREED TO USE IT ONLY FOR DRINKS. DO NOT USE THIS COOLER FOR TCS FOODS SUCH AS BOILED EGGS UNLESS IT IS FIXED. 2 46.37(a)-(h) - Certified Food Manager, Certification Process AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION, THERE MUST BE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER PRESENT IN FACILITY. YOU MUST GET ANOTHER STAFF MEMBER CERTIFIED BY MAY 7, 2026.
